safety_state.label: No Data
required_conditions_to_exit: Start a data source (simulator, replay, or hardware).

lock_reasons: Real EEG closed-loop adaptation is disabled by default.
Shadow inference has not been completed.
Timing validation has not been completed.
required_unlock_conditions: Achieve sustained signal quality above safety thresholds.
Complete shadow inference with acceptable results.
Complete timing validation with acceptable jitter and drift.

signal_quality_issues: SQI not evaluated in offline audit. Run make validate-brainflow-synthetic or make lsl-live-validation-suite for live SQI evidence.
required_steps_for_closed_loop: Achieve sustained signal quality above safety thresholds.
Complete shadow inference with acceptable results.
Complete timing validation with acceptable jitter and drift.
scientific_disclaimer: Closed-loop from real EEG is disabled by default. Hardware validation confirms stream quality and software integration; it does not validate clinical or unrestricted mental-state inference. The corridor is not a decoded mental image. It is an adaptive scaffold driven by experimental proxy metrics.
